title: Mental health matters – It's okay to ask for help
content:
Mujhe bhi kabhi kabhi anxiety hoti thi. Pehle samajh nahi aata tha ki kya karu. Fir maine apne doston aur family se baat ki.

Agar aap bhi aisa feel kar rahe ho, toh please akela mat raho.

Help maangna kamzori nahi, himmat hai. 💙
